items.question: How long does it take to have my website ready?
items.answer: It depends on the scope, but most projects are ready within 2 to 4 weeks from the initial meeting.

items.question: Can I request changes after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We offer maintenance and continuous improvement plans so your website evolves with your business.

items.question: What exactly is an AI chatbot?
items.answer: A virtual assistant trained with your business information that answers questions and captures leads automatically, 24/7.

items.question: Do you work with businesses in any industry?
items.answer: Yes, we adapt every project to the specific industry and needs of each client.

items.question: Does the website include hosting and domain?
items.answer: We can advise and manage hosting and domain if you need it, or work with the ones you already have.

items.question: How do we start working together?
items.answer: With a first no-commitment meeting to understand your project and propose the best solution.

items.question: Do you offer automation without a full website build?
items.answer: Yes, automation and chatbots can be hired independently.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: We work with modern technologies like Next.js, React and state-of-the-art AI integrations.
